categories.main_business_segments: Sunwoda Electronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the lithium-ion battery industry, focusing on three main segments: consumer batteries (including mobile phone and notebook batteries), electric vehicle batteries (power batteries), and energy storage systems. Additionally, the company is involved in precision structural parts and intelligent hardware businesses. It also engages in lithium-ion battery materials, high-performance membrane materials, automation equipment, and electronic product R&D, production, and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced lithium-ion battery technologies including silicon anode batteries, fast-charging batteries, high-capacity energy storage cells, and integrated mobile energy storage vehicles. It has proprietary battery management systems (BMS) that monitor and manage battery safety and performance. Manufacturing incorporates high automation and intelligent factory practices, with continuous R&D in solid-state batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and high-nickel cathode materials. The company also develops AI-driven simulation systems and industrial robots to enhance production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sunwoda serves major global consumer electronics brands in smartphones, notebooks, and wearable devices, as well as leading domestic and international electric vehicle manufacturers including traditional and new energy vehicle makers. Its energy storage systems cater to grid storage, commercial, and residential applications, with customers in China, the US, Europe, Australia, Japan, and the Middle East. The company also supplies precision parts and intelligent hardware to various industrial and consumer sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Nanjing, Nanchang, Zaozhuang, and other cities. It has expanded globally with facilities and projects in Vietnam, Hungary, Thailand, Morocco, India, Germany, the US, and Hong Kong. Overseas markets include North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Australia, with a growing footprint in emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sunwoda operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell and module manufacturing, battery pack assembly, and system integration. It also invests upstream in raw materials and components through joint ventures and equity stakes to secure supply and reduce cost volatility. The company provides ODM and OEM services, integrating design, development, and production for brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in battery chemistry, fast-charging technology, energy density improvement, and safety. R&D priorities include silicon anode batteries, solid-state batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and high-nickel cathode materials. It invests in digitalization, AI-driven simulation, intelligent manufacturing, and battery lifecycle management. Strategic goals include expanding global production capacity, deepening customer collaboration, and advancing energy storage solutions aligned with green and low-carbon development.
categories.revenue_model: Sunwoda generates revenue mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion battery cells, modules, and packs to consumer electronics manufacturers, electric vehicle makers, and energy storage system integrators. It also earns income from precision parts and intelligent hardware sales. The company operates primarily on a product sales model with some customized ODM/OEM contracts. Additionally, it receives investment income and government subsidies related to innovation and green energy projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sunwoda is positioned as a leading global lithium-ion battery manufacturer, ranking among the top ten worldwide in power battery installation capacity and holding a strong domestic market position. It competes with major battery producers in China and internationally, leveraging its technological innovation, diversified product portfolio, and global production network. The company is recognized for its advanced fast-charging batteries and integrated energy storage solutions, maintaining competitive advantages in quality, safety, and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sunwoda reported total revenue of approximately RMB 56.02 billion, a 17.05% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 1.47 billion, up 36.43%. The company’s assets totaled RMB 87.32 billion, growing 10.17% from the previous year. It has sustained robust growth driven by expanding consumer battery sales, rapid growth in electric vehicle battery shipments (116.89% increase), and breakthroughs in energy storage systems (107% growth). R&D investment increased to over RMB 3.33 billion, representing 5.94% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunwoda emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, advanced battery management systems, and high automation manufacturing to deliver high-performance, safe, and reliable lithium-ion batteries. Its product differentiation lies in fast-charging technology, high energy density, and customized solutions for diverse applications including AI-enabled consumer electronics and electric vehicles. The company’s integrated energy storage systems and digital battery lifecycle management platforms provide comprehensive green energy solutions, reinforcing its commitment to sustainability and customer-centric innovation.
